issues.problem: Non-focus slot トイレに行きました listed only に, but へ is equally natural for a destination.
Verb values 手紙を書きました and メールを送りました make へ an equally natural alternative for the focus slot. This conflicts with the に-only answer shared by the other verbs.
issues.action: Replaced them with 挨拶しました (greeted) and 聞きました (asked). Both take only に, and を is plainly wrong with them. The pack still has 8 verbs and 448 combinations.
